# Linewidth Results (MURI Review)

- Results seem to match fairly well

- Issue

  - Previous linewidth estimates were based on the intensity/RF spectrum,
    $|\mathcal{F}(|E(t)|^2)|$.

  - For the optical linewidth of the full field, we should instead use the
    field spectrum, $|\mathcal{F}(E(t))|^2$.

  - The intensity spectrum removes the optical phase information



---
# Coupling Matrix Definition ($M$ lasers)



- $\boldsymbol{\kappa}_c = \kappa_cA$

  - $\kappa_c$ is the overall coupling budget

--

- $A\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times M}$ with $\sum A_{ij} = 1$ and $A=A^T$ 


--

- All-to-all coupling, no self-coupling $A=\frac{1}{M(M-1)}(\mathbf{1}_{M\times M}-\mathbf{I}_{M\times M})$

  - For $M=2$ lasers, $A=\frac{1}{2}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$

  - For $M=3$ lasers, $A=\frac{1}{6}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$

# $T_{max}$ Convergence


- Linewidths computed with $T_{max}=1~\mu\mathrm{s}$

--

- FFT bin resolution: $\Delta f = 1/T_{max} = 1$ MHz

--

- Compute linewidths for $T_{max}\in[0.2,5]~\mu\mathrm{s}$

--

- Maximum resolution: $\Delta f = 1/(5\mu\mathrm{s}) = 200$ kHz

--

![:video 80%, 10%, 19%](../figs/linewidth_reduction_anim.mp4)

# $T_{max}$ Convergence

![:img 50%, 50%, 20%](../figs/linewidth_surface_3d_Etot_vs_kappa_Tmax_smooth1.0bins.png)


- Claims <100 Hz linewidth (20,000 $\mu\mathrm{s}$!!)

.footnote[Ma, W., Xiong, B., Sun, C., Ke, X., Wang, J., Hao, Z., ... & Luo, Y. (2019). Linewidth narrowing of mutually injection locked semiconductor lasers with short and long delay. Applied Sciences, 9(7), 1436.]

--

- Intrinsic linewidth inferred

  - White noise floor computed from PSD

--

- Noise floor $Hz^2/Hz$ $\to$ Linewidth $Hz$

- Lorentzian linewidth $\Delta\nu = \pi S_{\nu}(f)$

- <b>Not from optical spectrum</b>

# $\text{GMD}\to\kappa$



- Previous estimate of $\kappa_{th}$ was based on equilibrium points

--

- Noise changes the system

--

- Need to estimate $\kappa_{th}$ using system with noise to compare to experiment (GMD)

--

- Goal: Compute $\kappa_{th}$ as a function of detuning

--

- Use order parameter to determine $\kappa_{th}$

count: false
# Estimating $\kappa_{th}$ with Noise

- Approach: Vary detuning $0\to 5$ GHz, and for each detuning, vary $\kappa$ to find the point where the order parameter goes above 0.7

--

- Threshold Coupling Fraction: $R_{th} = \mathrm{sinc}(d_{th}-1)^{q}$, $q\in[1.6,2]$

--

- $|\kappa_{th}| = \sqrt{R_{th}}|\kappa_{c}|$

--

![:img 40%, 60%, 45%](../figs/tcf_detuning.png)

--

- Maximum $\delta=10.68$ GHz $~(d_{th}=1,~q=1.6)$


---
count: false

count: false
# Estimating $\kappa_{th}$ with Noise

- Approach: Vary detuning $0\to 5$ GHz, and for each detuning, vary $\kappa$ to find the point where the order parameter goes above 0.7

- Plot order parameter map over $\kappa$ and detuning

--

![:img 40%, 55%, 35%](../figs/order_parameter_map.png)


--

- Use maximum detuning (10.68 Ghz)
- $\kappa_{max}=41.26$ $ns^{-1}$


--

- Solve $\sqrt{R_{1.6}} = \frac{\kappa_c}{\kappa_{\max}}$

- $R_{1.6} = \mathrm{sinc}(d_m-1)^{1.6}$

- To get $\kappa_{c}=f(d_{m})$




---
# Comparing to Experiment

- $\kappa_{th} = 3.8\delta + 0.68$ (Simulation)

![:img 35%, 60%, 2%](../figs/order_parameter_map.png)

--

![:img 35%, 60%, 50%](../figs/tcf_detuning.png)


- $\sqrt{\mathrm{sinc}(d_{th}-1)^{1.6}} = 0.091\delta + 0.029$ (Experiment)

--

$\implies\kappa_{th} =41.75\sqrt{\left(\mathrm{sinc}(d_{th}-1)^{1.6}\right)}-0.531$

![:img 45%, 5%, 50%](../figs/critical_kappa_vs_grating_depth.png)
